items.title: HypoPG 1.4.5 is out!
items.summary: Tainan, Taiwan - Sun  1 Nov 2026HypoPG 1.4.5I'm pleased to announce the release of the version 1.4.5 of HypoPG, anextension adding support for Hypothetical Indexes, compatible with PostgreSQL9.2 and above.ChangelogBug fixes:Fix long standing thinko in hypo_estimate_index (Julien Rouhaud)Fix relid handling in hypothetical indexes, that could lead to a crash  (Julien Rouhaud)Links & CreditsThank to the users who reported bugs, they are all cited in the CHANGELOG file.HypoPG is an open project. Any contribution to build a better tool is welcome.You just have to send your ideas, features requests or patches using the githubrepository at github.com/HypoPG/hypopg.LinksDownload: github.com/HypoPG/hypopg/releasesBug tracker: github.com/HypoPG/hypopg/issues
